description:
Which attributes do winning products have? What should my product or listing include?
(¿Qué atributos tienen los productos que triunfan? ¿Qué debe llevar mi producto o mi ficha?)

Match categories (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles, `disponibles`; e.g. serums on Amazon Spain): attributes
and 2-3 attribute combinations that set the winning launches of a category apart. For Scan-only categories use
wintraits_scan_perfil. Useful beyond Amazon too: to design a product, brief a manufacturer or write the page of
an own shop or another marketplace (measured on Amazon: a reference, not proof elsewhere).

Each row has the lift (how many times more frequent among winners), the lift when checked against products
launched later, the products behind it and the share of products with that attribute that end up winning.
`tramos` explains what "bajo" (low), "medio" (medium) and "alto" (high) mean for numeric variables. On the free
plan you see the attribute with the most effect and how the strongest combination starts
(`combinacion_mas_fuerte`); `bloqueado` says how many more the full list has and `acceso` which view was used.

Args:
    categoria: subcategory (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles; e.g. "serums").
    pais: country code (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles; e.g. "ES").
    max_resultados: rows per list (1-50).
    lang: "es" (default) or "en" (attribute names in English).

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-03-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-mar-2027).
